# Milestone brief — paper-metadata-m1

**Title:** Existing notebook hydrated with arXiv metadata
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** paper-metadata (plans/paper-metadata/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** 2026-07-06 -> 2026-07-17

## Parent epic

- paper-metadata-e1 — Metadata store + arXiv hydration
  Per-notebook papers metadata store (SQLite, notebooks_store.py pattern) hydrated from the arXiv Atom API via tools/_arxiv_api.py at ingest, plus a backfill driver for already-populated notebooks — one vertical slice from external source to on-disk store, observable via a hydrated bridgeland-stability notebook.

## Summary

(none in roadmap — derive scope from the acceptance criteria)

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the bridgeland-stability notebook, when the backfill driver runs, then >=95% of its arxiv-kind paper_ids have a metadata row with non-NULL title and authors
2. Given a hydrated store, when the process restarts and the store is reopened cold, then metadata is served without touching the chunks table

## Depends on

- paper-metadata-spike-1 — Atom API field coverage across corpus ID shapes [status: planned]
